# Program Registration Platform

> A web platform by NTS Digital Solutions for running program registrations: build registration forms, share them by link or QR code, review applicants, issue ID cards and tickets, and verify them at the door by QR code or barcode.

## Main pages

- [Home](/): what the platform does, features, designs, and FAQ
- [Create an account](/register): start a free workspace for your organization
- [Sign in](/login)
- [Contact](/contact): questions, demos, and support (hello@ntsdigitalsolutions.com)
- [Report a concern](/report): report misuse, suspicious programs, or security issues

## Policies

- [Terms of service](/terms)
- [Privacy policy](/privacy)
- [Cookie policy](/cookies)
- [Acceptable use policy](/acceptable-use)

## Public program pages

Each published program has a page at /programs/{slug} and a registration form at /programs/{slug}/register. The full list is in [the sitemap](/sitemap.xml).
